sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **Searching Arrays** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: Linear search checks each element sequentially until the target is found or the array ends
Linear search has O(n) time complexity: it checks up to all n elements
Binary search requires a sorted array and repeatedly halves the search range
Binary search has O(log n) time complexity, much faster for large sorted arrays
Both methods return the index if found, or -1 (or a negative value) if not found
